issues.title: Node.js engine version not declared
issues.description: package.json does not declare an engines.node constraint.
issues.reason: Without an engine constraint, contributors may run an unsupported Node version.
issues.recommendation: Add an "engines.node" field matching your minimum supported Node version (>=20 recommended).
issues.impact: Runtime drift across environments can cause build or runtime failures.

issues.title: No .nvmrc or .node-version file found
issues.description: A Node.js project without a version pin file.
issues.reason: Version managers like nvm/fnm/volta use these files to auto-switch.
issues.recommendation: Add an .nvmrc file with the Node version (e.g. "20").
issues.impact: Contributors may run different Node versions locally.
issues.suggestedAction: Create .nvmrc with the target Node version.
